# Settings preference toggles

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Each toggle saves on change through one update endpoint and confirms with a toast.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make settings-section --flavor=toggles <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui SettingsFrame, @kit/ui Section, @kit/ui Checkbox.
- `SettingsFrame` from `@kit/ui` for the settings shell: The settings layout and nav (props: title).
- `Section` from `@kit/ui` for the group: Groups related preferences (props: title).
- `Checkbox` from `@kit/ui` for the toggle: An on/off preference that saves on change (props: v-model, label).
Checks: 20, 21, toast. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Does the settings group need its own nav section, or join an existing settings class?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=settings.toggles` to see its siblings.
